design_detail: Ley Constitucional que crea el Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios: 0.25% to 1.5% of net wealth above 36 million tax units (individuals) or 100 million (companies)
quote_original: La Asamblea Nacional Constituyente (ANC), integrada por militantes del chavismo, aprobó este martes la creación de un impuesto a los grandes patrimonios
quote_en: The National Constituent Assembly (ANC), made up of Chavista militants, approved on Tuesday the creation of a tax on large fortunes
source_title: La Constituyente chavista aprueba un impuesto a los grandes patrimonios
grading_note: The assembly passed the law (en bloque); the thresholds were later raised to 150 million tax units in the reprint. The ANC is not recognised by much of the international community.

design_detail: Defence of the Ley Constitucional que crea el Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios (0.25% to 1.5% of total wealth)
quote_original: Esta ley a los grandes patrimonios es que el que más tiene más paga, y el que menos tiene no paga
quote_en: This law on large fortunes means that whoever has most pays more, and whoever has least pays nothing
source_title: La Constituyente chavista aprueba un impuesto a los grandes patrimonios
grading_note: His own words, quoted by EFE, presenting the named law to the assembly and giving its rates; a formal act as the member explaining the bill.

design_detail: Announced a Ley de Impuesto al Patrimonio for Venezuelans abroad
quote_original: Vamos a promover el que se considere una Ley de Impuesto al Patrimonio
quote_en: We are going to promote that a Wealth Tax Law be considered
source_title: Proponen impuesto para bienes de venezolanos en el exterior
grading_note: Names a wealth tax law (B); he says its main aim is to register the assets of Venezuelans worldwide more than to raise revenue, and gives no rate, threshold or bill text.

design_detail: Opened the 2023-24 filing and payment period of the Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios (net wealth of 150 million tax units or more)
quote_original: El pago de este impuesto es una forma de contribuir al desarrollo social y económico del país
quote_en: Paying this tax is a way of contributing to the country's social and economic development
source_title: Seniat inicia plazo para declaración y pago del impuesto a los grandes patrimonios
publisher: Ministerio del Poder Popular de Economía, Finanzas y Comercio Exterior (Prensa Seniat)
grading_note: Official press release of the tax authority urging payment of the existing wealth tax; administering the law, no rate stated in the text. Not a vote or a new proposal.

design_detail: Signed the Ley Constitucional que crea el Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios as first vice-president of the ANC
source_title: Gaceta Oficial 41.667 of 3 July 2019: Ley Constitucional que crea el Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios (copy by Travieso Evans)
publisher: Gaceta Oficial de la República Bolivariana de Venezuela (law firm copy)
grading_note: Signature line under 'Cúmplase' at the end of the law, which closes with the sixth transitional provision of the original text; the signature is one of the ANC board's. The copy is the law firm's, not the official Gaceta.

design_detail: Signed as president of the ANC the notice that reprinted the Ley Constitucional que crea el Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios and corrected its thresholds
source_title: Gaceta Oficial 41.696 of 16 August 2019: aviso oficial reprinting the Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios law (Venamcham copy)
publisher: Gaceta Oficial de la República Bolivariana de Venezuela (Venamcham copy)
grading_note: Signature of the presiding officer on the official notice that republishes the law; the notice corrects errors and does not itself vote the tax, so B. His signature on the law of 2 July 2019 was not readable.

design_detail: Higher "impuesto a la riqueza" to fund wage rises
quote_original: Aumentamos el impuesto a la riqueza para pagar los aumentos salariales de los trabajadores y redistribuimos la riqueza
quote_en: Let us raise the wealth tax to pay for the workers' wage rises and redistribute wealth
source_title: Venezuela. “Más impuestos para los ricos para subir los salarios”. Entrevista al dirigente sindical Octavio Solórzano
grading_note: Names an "impuesto a la riqueza" but the interview is framed as more taxes on the rich and gives no design, so C; the phrase may refer to the existing IGP or to taxes on the rich in general.

design_detail: Presented the Ley Constitucional que crea el Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios to the ANC plenary
quote_original: reconoce que en Venezuela sí existen grandes patrimonios; donde hay personas naturales y personas jurídicas que tienen bienes importantes y la ANC quiere que hagan un aporte a la nación a través de un impuesto
quote_en: recognises that large fortunes do exist in Venezuela, with individuals and companies holding important assets, and the ANC wants them to contribute to the nation through a tax
source_title: En Gaceta Ley de Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios
grading_note: His own words in the plenary, quoted by El Universal (the article is of 11 July 2019), presenting the named law; a formal act as presenter of the bill.

design_detail: Presented the law as chair of the ANC economy commission (30 articles, six transitional provisions)
quote_original: Esta ley, representan un paso modesto pero importante en la dirección correcta para atender el déficit fiscal
quote_en: This law is a modest but important step in the right direction to address the fiscal deficit
source_title: En Gaceta Ley de Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios
grading_note: His own words in the plenary, as chair of the economy commission explaining the named law; the quote says only "esta ley", which the article identifies as the Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios law.
